name: shinkolab
description: ShinkoLab 的 Claude Code 插件：幻燈 GENTO 代码动画短片、文房 BUNBO 社交图文卡片。

plugins.name: gento
plugins.description: 幻燈 GENTO: turn a brief into a code-drawn animated short film with its own soundtrack. Nine styles, four formats, three languages.

plugins.name: bunbo
plugins.description: 文房 BUNBO: turn source material into a ready-to-post card set (Xiaohongshu long post, Japanese and English Instagram cards, captions, hashtags). Local rendering, no cloud API.
